title: Sklar Bikes SuperSomething Now Ships Standard with a Carbon Fork
content:
Last year, got to check out the new Sklar Bikes SuperSomething with a few choice updates. These new framesets have finally landed, and yes, they’re shipping with either standard with a carbon ($1,900 frameset) or with an optional steel fork ($1,599 frameset) from Sklar Bikes in San Francisco…

Revisions

The Sklar SuperSomething is a versatile bike with clearance for a 2.2″ tire and non-boost spacing, while maintaining the look and feel of a drop bar gravel road bike. As a small business, Sklar Bikes looks at each restock as an opportunity to make slight adjustments to its models. When it comes to the SuperSomething, this new batch has a few refinements, including now shipping standard with the Sklar-designed, 530-gram carbon fork. This is the same bike model that Spencer reviewed and John photographed at Grinduro in 2025.

2026 SuperSomething Quick Hits

  • Made in Taiwan
  • $1,900 steel frame and carbon fork
  • $1,599 steel frame and steel fork
  • Complete bikes start at $4,850
  • Carbon fork weight 530 g
  • New colors: Atmospheric River and Golden Hills (pictured)
  • UDH dropouts
  • Flat-mount disc brakes
  • New cast chainstay yoke
  • Frame is also compatible with ENVE Adventure Fork (not included)
  • Non-boost 142 x 12 mm rear, 100 x 12 mm front spacing
  • 27.2 mm seatpost
  • Clearance for 700 x 55 mm
  • 3 bottle cages, one under the down tube
  • 68 mm BSA Bottom bracket Shell
  • Compatible with EC34 mm /44 mm Headset
  • Clearance for up to a 44 tooth single chainring

New for this edition of the SuperSomething are UDH dropouts, a cast steel chainstay yoke, and flat-mount disc brakes. Sklar also refined the tubing all around, and with the new UDH dropouts, the frames got ~1.5 pounds lighter.

Geometry

The geometry remained the same, but the SuperSomething sizing was adjusted slightly to accommodate the fit of a couple of hundred people over the past several years. There’s now a new size XL, which is approximately a 62 cm size, available as well.

SuperSomething Carbon (or Steel) Fork Yeah

The new SuperSomething batch comes with either a steel fork with slimmer blades and flat-mount brakes. Or the in-house-designed Sklar carbon fork, painted to match the frame.

These new frames and forks are in stock and shipping today from Sklar Bikes.
